title: La Cour des Sources
art_contract: Canonical native1920x1200 map. Use this exact217-cell FLOOR union for the visible stone surface, tactical overlay and top-of-pit/perimeter geometry. Painted environment begins outside the same stepped envelope. No additional painted courtyard or independently scaled grid. The16 listed pit cells are VOID; the northwest pillar cell remains solid FLOOR and BLOCKED. Perimeter bench sections are external decor, already outside playable terrain. All source geometry marked inferred remains an explicit authoring decision, not an exact extraction of Dofus collision data.
